first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The taller man with a short buzz cut on the image-left, wearing a dark zip-up jacket and dark trousers.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The man on the image-right wearing a dark close-fitting knit cap, a loose dark leather jacket, a light-colored turtleneck top, and light-colored trousers.

entities.name: multistory buildings along the street
entities.identification: The multistory buildings on both sides of the road and the spired building in the central distance, with the background clearly out of focus.

entities.name: city road
entities.identification: The road at a lower elevation behind the people, converging toward the central distance between the buildings on both sides.

entities.name: sky
entities.identification: The light-gray areas of sky above the rooftops and in the gaps between the central buildings.

entities.name: group of road vehicles
entities.identification: The background traffic group on the central road, mainly appearing as out-of-focus vehicle lights and blurry light and dark patches.

entities.name: dark metal railing
entities.identification: The dark horizontal top rail extending across the image behind the people, with spaced vertical posts.

entities.name: stone parapet
entities.identification: The parapet area below the railing, with a broad dark horizontal band at the top and a mottled light-gray wall surface below.

entities.name: streetlights along the street
entities.identification: The streetlight behind Person A on the image-left, with a broad, flat lamp head and a slender pole.

entities.name: spat-out saliva
entities.identification: The light-colored liquid strand and droplets that appear below Person A's mouth and then fall toward the lower image-left.
